# Product Ontology authority fixtures

Unmodified Turtle documents captured from Product Ontology on October 23, 2026. Source URLs, retrieval metadata and SHA-256 checksums are in `source-manifest.json`. These six documents test exact class declarations; the company-specific offering assignments are separate reviewed decisions in `ontology-mappings.json`.

The documents retain their copyright, attribution and license annotations. Product Ontology's class definitions identify Wikipedia as their source and are licensed under [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Those source terms continue to apply to the fixtures. No license for the rest of this repository is implied by their inclusion.
